G0616.definition: ἀπο-κυέω; (Rec. -κύω), -ῶ (ἀπό, κυέω or κύω, to be pregnant),  ; prop., "the medical word for birth as the close of pregnancy" (Hort, Ja., 26 f.). In κοιν, "an ordinary syn. of τίκτω, but definitely 'perfectivised' (M, Pr., 111 ff.; MM, see word) by the; ἀπό, and so implying safe delivery," to bring forth, give birth to: Jas.1:15, 18.†; (AS)

G0668.definition: ἀπο-φεύγω; to flee from, escape: with accusative, 2Pe.2:18 2:20; with genitive, 2Pe.1:4.†; (AS)

G0679.definition: ἄ-πταιστος, -ον; (πταίω),  ; without stumbling, sure-footed: metaphorically (MM, see word), Ju 24.†; (AS)
